related_questions.question: How long does it take for PCR test results to come back?

text_blocks.snippet: The turnaround time for PCR test results can vary, but generally, it takes about 1 to 3 days to receive results. For common viruses like COVID-19 and influenza, results are often available within a day. More complex PCR tests, like those involving blood tests or biopsies, may take a week or longer. Some point-of-care PCR tests can provide results more quickly, according to the CDC.
